# AttractionScout

> Travel attraction guide covering 13+ cities with 195+ curated listings, ratings, local tips, and free itinerary planning tools

## About

AttractionScout is a free travel attractions, city guides & trip planning platform at [attractionscout.com](https://attractionscout.com). Founded in 2024.

- 195+ curated attraction listings across 13+ cities
- Local expert reviews and insider tips
- Free itinerary planning tools
- Updated pricing and hours for all attractions

## Tools & Calculators

- [Attraction Finder](https://attractionscout.com/): Browse top-rated attractions by city and category
- [Itinerary Planner](https://attractionscout.com/itinerary-planner): Build a personalized day-by-day travel itinerary
- [City Guides](https://attractionscout.com/cities): Comprehensive guides for 13+ popular destinations
- [Budget Calculator](https://attractionscout.com/budget-calculator): Estimate attraction costs for your trip
